name: Neural Deferred Shading
definition: A method to model view-dependent appearance using a lightweight shared MLP applied per pixel, taking rasterized feature vectors and viewing direction as input, while keeping opacity outside the network.
summary: Neural Deferred Shading is a radiance field decoding strategy that separates view-independent opacity from view-dependent color, using a lightweight MLP to efficiently model appearance without high-order spherical harmonics.
